name: Erlang
runtime: BEAM VM (bytecode interpreted + JIT in OTP 25+)
concurrencyModel: Actor model: lightweight processes with message passing, preemptive scheduling, no shared memory

codeExample.source:
-module(hello).
-export([start/0]).

start() ->
    Pid = spawn(fun() -> loop() end),
    Pid ! {self(), "Hello!"},
    receive
        {Pid, Reply} -> io:format("Got: ~s~n", [Reply])
    end.

loop() ->
    receive
        {From, Msg} -> From ! {self(), Msg ++ " World"}
    end.
